verdict.rationale: Marqeta's Gateway JIT Funding docs say the platform funds accounts at transaction time by sending funding requests to your system, which approves or denies them using your own business rules. That is real-time per-authorization decisioning by developer code. The evidence does not mention the network's response-time budget or a configurable timeout or fallback behavior, and the webhooks it cites are only after-the-fact event notifications. Missing for 10: documented response-time budget, developer-controlled timeout fallback (e.g., default approve/decline on timeout), and hands-on or independent corroboration.
